navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border, app icon + 'StockFlow' title left (navbar__brand), nav links right (navbar__links). Active link uses brand-red. Tap targets >=44x44px.

page.notes: warm-oat (--color-page) background, centered content column max 960px, page__header holds app icon + page__title. All screens compose page.

card.notes: white surface, --radius-md, navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --space-5 padding. Stock table and detail panels live in cards.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red, sharp 0px corners, hover brand-red-hover), btn--secondary (outlined navy), btn--ghost (text-only). Tap target >=44x44px.

form_input.notes: persistent visible label (field__label, never placeholder-only), --radius-sm, focus ring --color-info. Inline validation via field__error next to the field, naming the field.

table.notes: cool uppercase header row (stock-table__head), quantity cells right-aligned using --font-mono + tabular-nums. Calm, high-contrast, scannable.

status_badge.notes: pill (--radius-pill), --text-xs uppercase; state carried by BOTH text and color, never color alone.

empty_state.notes: line icon + teaching heading + copy + a CTA, never a blank region. E.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'. Also 'not tracked' for SKUs with no batch/serial detail.

toast.notes: fixed top-right; toast--success auto-dismisses, toast--error persists. Never shifts page layout.

scan_zone.notes: barcode input zone; on success flashes green (scan-zone--success) and stock row updates in place, on failure flashes red (scan-zone--error) and shows a persistent error toast.

app_icon.notes: warehouse brand mark from client/src/assets/warehouse.png, shown in navbar__brand and page__header next to 'StockFlow'. Favicon variant in the browser tab (client/index.html).
